title: Peppers and eggplants
summary: Grow warm-season fruiting crops with early establishment and steady heat management.
steps: Start with healthy transplants when the local warm season is long enough and nights are no longer cold.
Provide full suitable light, warm soil and enough container or bed volume.
Keep root-zone moisture steady while avoiding waterlogged soil.
Support heavy branches and inspect leaf undersides for mites, aphids and whiteflies.
Harvest with clean cutters to avoid tearing branches; record which varieties set fruit during local heat.
